Diagnosis.submission: The recommendation service (srv-recommendation, port 8085) in namespace hotel-reservation is unreachable for new connections. Root cause: a NetworkPolicy named "deny-all-recommendation" selects pods with label io.kompose.service=recommendation and specifies both Ingress and Egress policyTypes but contains NO ingress/egress allow rules, so it denies all incoming and outgoing traffic to/from the recommendation pods. Evidence: (1) blackbox TCP probe to recommendation.hotel-reservation:8085 abruptly degraded from ~0.004s to exactly 5.0s (timeout) and probe_success=0, while all other services (geo, rate, profile, search, user, reservation, frontend) probe in <1ms with probe_success=1; (2) a direct TCP connect to recommendation:8085 hangs/times out while connects to every other service succeed instantly; (3) the frontend cannot fetch recommendations on fresh connections, but requests still return because its gRPC connection to recommendation was established before the NetworkPolicy was created. The faulty component is the NetworkPolicy deny-all-recommendation blocking the recommendation service; the fix is to remove it (or add allow rules).
